# airs mcp

```text
Optional runtime MCP service: connections and sign-in

Usage: airs mcp [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  connections  Manage named connections in the selected tenant (no secrets)
  login        Sign in to a connection (PKCE, loopback callback; the only interactive command on an ordinary connection)
  logout       Remove the private session of a connection
  status       Connections, sessions and unresolved operation receipts (local, no network)
  confirm      Approve another actor's lifecycle preview (admin connection; a fresh sign-in)
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --output <format>  Output format: pretty, table, json
      --quiet            Suppress status and decorative output (data and errors still print)
      --debug            Write redacted API diagnostics to a private JSONL file
      --tenant <name>    Use this registered tenant for one invocation without changing the selection
  -h, --help             Print help
```

## airs mcp connections

```text
Manage named connections in the selected tenant (no secrets)

Usage: airs mcp connections [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  list    List the selected tenant's connections
  set     Add or replace a connection; the first write saves a private rollback snapshot
  remove  Remove a connection
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --output <format>  Output format: pretty, table, json
      --quiet            Suppress status and decorative output (data and errors still print)
      --debug            Write redacted API diagnostics to a private JSONL file
      --tenant <name>    Use this registered tenant for one invocation without changing the selection
  -h, --help             Print help
```

### airs mcp connections set

```text
Add or replace a connection; the first write saves a private rollback snapshot

Usage: airs mcp connections set [OPTIONS] --url <URL> --client-id <ID> --service-tenant <ID> --expected-tsg <TSG> --approved-origin <ORIGIN> <CONNECTION>

Arguments:
  <CONNECTION>  Connection name

Options:
      --output <format>           Output format: pretty, table, json
      --url <URL>                 Gateway MCP route (HTTPS; loopback HTTP only for tests)
      --client-id <ID>            Public OAuth client ID (no secret)
      --quiet                     Suppress status and decorative output (data and errors still print)
      --debug                     Write redacted API diagnostics to a private JSONL file
      --service-tenant <ID>       Expected public service tenant
      --expected-tsg <TSG>        Expected TSG of the service's archive
      --tenant <name>             Use this registered tenant for one invocation without changing the selection
      --approved-origin <ORIGIN>  An origin discovery and sign-in may use (repeatable; must include the URL's)
      --role <ROLE>               ordinary or admin [default: ordinary]
      --replace                   Replace an existing connection (a new revision invalidates its session)
  -h, --help                      Print help
```

## airs mcp login

```text
Sign in to a connection (PKCE, loopback callback; the only interactive command on an ordinary connection)

Usage: airs mcp login [OPTIONS] <CONNECTION>

Arguments:
  <CONNECTION>  Connection name

Options:
      --open             Open the authorization URL in a browser (otherwise it is only printed)
      --output <format>  Output format: pretty, table, json
      --port <N>         Loopback callback port (0 picks a free port) [default: 0]
      --quiet            Suppress status and decorative output (data and errors still print)
      --debug            Write redacted API diagnostics to a private JSONL file
      --tenant <name>    Use this registered tenant for one invocation without changing the selection
  -h, --help             Print help
```

## airs mcp confirm

```text
Approve another actor's lifecycle preview (admin connection; a fresh sign-in)

Usage: airs mcp confirm [OPTIONS] --connection <CONNECTION> <PREVIEW_ID>

Arguments:
  <PREVIEW_ID>  The preview to approve (p1_…)

Options:
      --connection <CONNECTION>  The admin-role connection that signs the approval
      --output <format>          Output format: pretty, table, json
      --digest <SHA256>          The preview's parameter digest (default: the local preview record)
      --quiet                    Suppress status and decorative output (data and errors still print)
      --debug                    Write redacted API diagnostics to a private JSONL file
      --proof-nonce <HEX>        The preview's proof nonce (default: the local preview record)
      --open                     Open the sign-in URL in a browser (otherwise it is only printed)
      --tenant <name>            Use this registered tenant for one invocation without changing the selection
      --port <N>                 Loopback callback port (0 picks a free port) [default: 0]
  -h, --help                     Print help
```
